statement: For every compatible Context C [def-pur-completed-open-tensor-representative-data], the summand-normalized open total tensor chain isomorphism descends to a natural ordinary derived tensor isomorphism gamma : j!K tensor N ≅ j!(K tensor j*N). On every flat-term K-flat pair P,Q, and every proof that the restricted Q is K-flat, gamma satisfies the ordinary localization square using precisely sourceRepresentative, openRepresentative and the exact extension counit specified by C. This is only the ordinary representative assertion; it does not assert the strict scalar-unit augmentation or whole-system comparison. The coefficients and the site have independent universes and the complexes may be unbounded.

proof.text: At any given flat-term K-flat P,Q, substitute the localization component formula. Shriek of openRepresentative inverse cancels shriek of its hom, and the inverse extension counit cancels its hom. What remains is sourceRepresentative followed by Q of the total chain comparison, exactly the asserted ordinary square. The proof of K-flatness used to define the open representative is irrelevant, so the equation holds for every hR.

lean.statement: theorem openTensorOrdinaryDescent (C : Context l E j) : ∃ γ : OrdinaryMap l E j C, ∀ (P : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E U) ℤ) (Q : CochainComplex (scalarReductionSource l E V) ℤ) (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E U) P) (hQ : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E V) Q) (hfP : SemilinearSections.flatTerms.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E U) P) (_hfQ : SemilinearSections.flatTerms.{t + 1, t, max u (t + 1)} (Scheme.ProEt.topology V) (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E V) Q) (hR : CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients (R := completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E U) ((OpenSemilinearTensor.restrictionComplex l E j C.operations).obj Q)), (γ.hom.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P, DerivedCategory.Q.obj Q) ≫ (shriek l E j C.operations).map (openRepresentative l E j C P Q hP hR).hom ≫ (extension l E j C.operations).mapDerivedCategoryFactors.hom.app (openComplex l E j C P Q) = (sourceRepresentative l E j C P Q hP hQ hfP).hom ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (C.strictOpen.totalComparison.chain P Q).hom)
